map.国内常用改良版为 13 项加权、满分 63；原始 Kupperman 指数（Ab: The commonly used Chinese modified version has 13 weighted items and a maximum of 63; the original Kupperman index (Abe modification) has 11 items, a maximum of 51 and cutoffs of 15–20 / 21–35 / ≥36. The scores are not interchangeable.
map.不能单独诊断，需结合月经史、FSH 与雌激素水平；评分用于量化症状严重度、指导治: It cannot diagnose menopause alone; use it with menstrual history, FSH and estrogen levels. The score quantifies severity and guides treatment and follow-up.
